summary: Learn BIM information planning, IFC checks, issue workflows and handover through practical project exercises. Explore the 10-day foundation course.
lede: BIM training helps coordinators and project teams plan and check model information from project requirements through asset handover. Practical exercises cover drafting information requirements and a BIM execution plan, validating IFC exchanges, managing BCF issue workflows and preparing COBie-based handover information. The course also introduces operational uses of 4D and 5D BIM.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who contribute to model-based building or infrastructure project delivery and need a shared, practical approach to BIM information.
prerequisites: No BIM software experience is assumed. Familiarity with construction project drawings or project delivery is useful but not essential; coding or programming is not required.
